title: Emergent Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Emergent is a capable multi-agent AI app builder, but it falls short on billing, pricing predictability, and reliability. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Emergent's three biggest gaps natively, flat pricing instead of a 10x jump between tiers, native Stripe subscription billing instead of single Playbook templates, and a Visual Editor instead of chat-only iteration, and it's a more complete platform overall: documented reliability, a customer-facing AI gateway, built-in growth tooling, and human support when you're stuck are all things Emergent doesn't offer at any tier. More options are ranked in our[Emergent alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/emergent-alternatives) roundup.
